name: pawplete
description: Minimal inline code completion via a local Ollama model.

commands.title: Pawplete: Accept Next Line of Suggestion

enumDescriptions: Fill-in-the-middle via /api/generate. Fast and accurate; ignores instructions and thinking.
Chat via /api/chat. Uses the instructions and thinking settings.

pawplete.thinking.description: Chat mode only. Let the model think before answering (slower).

pawplete.instructions.default:
You are an inline code completion engine inside a code editor.
You will receive a file excerpt containing the marker <CURSOR>.
Reply with ONLY the code that should be inserted at <CURSOR>.
Rules:
- Do not repeat any code that already appears before or after the marker.
- Do not add explanations, comments about your reasoning, or markdown fences.
- Match the indentation, naming, and style of the surrounding code.
- Stop as soon as the immediate statement, block, or expression is complete.
pawplete.instructions.description: Chat mode only. System prompt sent to the model.

pawplete.contextLinesAbove.description: Maximum lines before the cursor sent as context.

pawplete.contextLinesBelow.description: Maximum lines after the cursor sent as context.

pawplete.crossFileContextChars.description: fim mode only. Characters of related code taken from other open files and added to the prompt. 0 disables.

pawplete.definitionContextChars.description: fim mode only. Characters of definitions, found through the language server, for the function being called and other symbols near the cursor. Only definitions in the workspace are used. 0 disables.

pawplete.maxLines.description: Maximum lines in a suggestion. With adaptiveLines on, this applies on blank lines only. 1 forces single-line completions.

pawplete.adaptiveLines.description: Suggest a single line when the cursor line already has code, and up to maxLines on a blank line.

pawplete.debounceMs.description: Delay after the last keystroke before requesting a completion.

pawplete.triggerMode.description: Automatic: suggest while typing. Manual: only on the trigger command.

pawplete.keepAlive.description: How long Ollama keeps the model loaded after a request (keep_alive).

pawplete.disabledLanguages.description: Language IDs that never trigger completions.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && tsc -p test/integration/tsconfig.json && node out-test/test/integration/runTest.js
scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies
